item.title: Peacekeepers plan to take over bases near Somalia’s capital as Ugandan troops withdraw
item.description: Peacekeepers plan to replace departing Ugandan troops at four bases near Somalia’s capital to prevent al-Shabab militants from exploiting a security vacuum.

item.title: Promising new HIV-prevention drug is hard to find where it's most needed, in places like Uganda
item.description: Experts say that a promising drug that offers complete protection against HIV and requires only two shots a year isn't getting to enough people.

item.title: Flood risks remain after storms forced evacuations in US Southwest, in photos
item.description: Powerful storms flooded parts of the U.S. Southwest, forcing hundreds to evacuate. Flood risks remained after the skies cleared, and officials said cleanup and repairs could take weeks.

item.title: Australia's highest court hears challenges to social media ban for children
item.description: Australia's highest court is hearing challenges to a law banning children younger than 16 from social media.

item.title: Suspected militants open fire and kill 2 police officers guarding polio workers in Pakistan
item.description: Suspected militants have shot and killed two police officers protecting polio workers during a vaccination campaign in northwestern Pakistan.
